newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures finish down, in range amid thin trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures finish down, in range amid thin trade.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed weaker on mixed selling that emerged just ahead of the close, dealers said.
Volume was light at an estimated 1,900 lots. Monday's official volume was 2,400 lots.
The May contract closed at 83.35 cents, down 1.35, having ranged from 85.50 to 83.15. The other contracts settled 1.35 weaker to 0.15 firmer.
A dearth of fundamental news is keeping activity dull, market sources said, adding that May could maintain its 80.00-85.00 cent trading range for the near term.

Florida's early and mid-season orange harvest is complete and the Valencia harvest is underway. The Florida Agricultural Statistics Service said an estimated 4,019,000 boxes of Valencia oranges were harvested in the week ended March 23, up from 2,295,000 in the prior week.
Brazil's Citrus Exporters' Association (Abecitrus) will publish its first estimate of the 1997/98 crop on May 20. Expectations are for strong and increasing output in both Brazil and the U.S.
